summary: Play 36 original Sudoku puzzles with pencil notes, undo and saved games.
release_notes: Adds three measured difficulty levels, saved answers and pencil notes, persistent undo, optional checking, clear completion and reachable landscape controls.
user: Somebody who wants a pencil-and-paper puzzle on their Kobo.
job: Play Sudoku with pencil notes, undo and optional checking, and come back to a half-finished puzzle.
offline: Every puzzle, note and save lives on the reader; it never touches the network.

data.kind: the puzzle in progress, with its answers, pencil notes and undo history
data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; it exists so a half-finished puzzle continues

non_goals: It does not download new puzzles.
It does not keep scores or statistics across puzzles.
